metric_recalculation_gaps.Warmup: Historical per-epoch training logits are not retained; recorded scalars are cross-checked to authentic live-loop journals and endpoint predictions are independently recomputed.
metric_recalculation_gaps.DARG: Per-epoch training logits are not retained; recorded scalars are cross-checked to authentic live-loop journals, while final patient predictions and probabilities are independently recomputed.
metric_recalculation_gaps.DPSL: Ten deterministic randomly selected epochs have stored raw train logits and labels, and their train and validation metrics are independently recomputed.
